messages:
rachel: Heads-up — canary rollout for strict fncall-validator started 02:00 UTC and we've got a spike of rejects. Console shows errors: 'validation_error: tool_response not object' for ~120 requests/min. Sample request:
```json
{"user_input":"Summarize sales Q1","tool_output":"\"Revenue up 12%\""}
```
Seems like a model variant returned a raw string instead of the expected structured object. Tagging @mike for validator ownership and @sam for routing policy/rollout.

mike: ack I'm looking. Is this only in eu-west canary? I see increased reject rate in the 'strict-validate' slice. Dashboard doesn't show route_id with reject metric which makes triage hard :/

sam: yeah, routing has been sending to `variant-v2` for that slice. I think variant-v2 has a new tool adapter that coerces outputs into strings when the tool signature is ambiguous. Will repro locally.

rachel: interesting — the trace logs we have show the reject happened pre-routing (validator attached to the ingress), so the route attribution is lost. ops-bot, can we get per-request route_attempts in traces?

ops-bot: @rachel created ticket INF-3287: add route_attempts and last_route_id to fncall_reject span. Link: https://tickets.redwood/INF-3287 :memo:

mike: quick proposal — add `reject_reason` and `route_id` tags to the validation metric `fncall.validation.rejects` so dashboards can filter. Also sample 0.1% of rejected payloads (redact pii) and send to a secure bucket for backfill.

jordan: UI note — console should surface 'validation step' in per-request flyout with a compact reason and a link to sampling logs. Without that, SRE will get stuck pattern hunting. I can mock a compact design (2 states: reason + link).

sam: I'll roll a hotfix to the adapter to ensure tool adapters return object when schema signals a function return. But we also need a backstop: if validator keeps rejecting >1% for 5m, routing should fallback to permissive route to avoid large user-facing regressions.

mike: agree on fallback feature toggle. For immediate triage I'm going to add the metric tags and sampling (will push a short-lived canary metric event). Also set an alert for >1% reject rate per slice in 1m.

rachel: thanks. Next steps: mike adds metric tags + sampling (owner: mike), sam patches adapter + fallback policy (owner: sam), jordan provides UI mock (owner: jordan). We'll reconvene in #eng-platform in 30m with status. :thumbsup:

mike: one more ask — when you paste sample payloads into the thread please include the full `x-route-hops` header from the request so we can verify where attribution is lost.

sam: will do, adding logs to INF-3287.

rachel: copying ops/sre on INF-3287 for visibility. Thanks all.
